name: print-social-editorial-orange-and-black-card-grid
title: Orange, black and grey editorial cards with serif italics and huge stats
whatItIs: A grid of rounded cards in black, orange and pale grey: a director portrait with name pill, 'Grow Smarter' with an arrow chip, a manifesto paragraph with a hand-drawn circle around 'converts', an orange card in italic serif, '84%' with a starburst, and '2.4K' with an orange K.
whatItMeans: Modern, editorial and confident; contrasting sans and italic serif give agency-level polish.
techniques: Mix a clean grotesque with italic serif in one card set.
Use huge stat numerals with a tiny explanatory caption.
Put arrow-in-pill icons as navigation chips.
Circle a key word with a hand-drawn ellipse.
Limit the palette to orange, black and grey.

vocabulary.definition: A small pill containing an arrow.
Italic serif type used to add elegance.
A scribbled oval around a word.
A card built around one large number.
